'''Hardfrost Base''' was the [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]-based headquarters of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Salmakk]]. After a run-in with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the base was heavily damaged and promptly abandoned by the pirate crew. What remained of Hardfrost was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to help construct [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].
